claims.statement: Q4 order intake grew 14% sequentially to Rs. 861 crores driven by non-glass lined technologies and system platforms
Consolidated EBITDA margin 13.8% for FY24; international margins improved while India margins stable
Previous guidance of Rs. 3,700 crores revenue and Rs. 630 crores EBITDA will be recalibrated; new three-year roadmap coming in next few quarters
New service center facility in Georgia, USA (51% JV) to be inaugurated in July for reglassing and service
Glass line capacity utilization at ~65%, other product lines at 70-75%; can operate at 90% with longer lead times
Starting FY25 with Rs. 1,700 crores backlog; peak was Rs. 2,200 crores, normal range Rs. 1,800-2,000 crores
New Mixing facility being set up in US for semiconductor industry tanks (all sizes) to support growth
International business margins expected to trade around same levels next financial year; confident of growing EBITDA in FY25
Q1 FY25 order intake was Rs.882 crores, highest in eight quarters; order backlog up 5% to Rs.1,777 crores
No expansion capex planned for FY25 or FY26; maintenance capex around 2-2.5% of revenue but likely lower
Consolidated order intake for H1 FY25 was ₹1,644 crores, up 18% vs H1 FY24
Consolidated order backlog as of September 30, 2024 was ₹1,773 crores, up 4% vs September 30, 2023
Full-year guidance flattish revenue (~3-4% growth) and margins similar to last year; H2 expected stronger than H1
Poland facility producing first equipment for Mavag; lower cost than Western Europe; English-speaking engineers and welders available
Consolidated order backlog as of December 31, 2024 was ₹1,740 crores
Consolidated order intake for Q3 FY25 was ₹798 crores
Standalone order backlog as of December 31, 2024 was ₹577 crores
International order backlog as of December 31, 2024 was ₹1,207 crores
Management expects to finish FY25 with EBITDA margins around 11-12% and aims to improve margins in FY26 but declines to give a specific number.
Consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 12% in Q3 FY25 from 11.6% in Q2 FY25; EBITDA up 3% sequentially.
Q3 order intake was INR 798 crore, up 5% sequentially; 9M order intake up 13% YoY; order backlog stands at INR 1,740 crore, up 7% vs Dec 31, 2023.
Investment agreement executed for Poland manufacturing facility; first orders already produced there with good quality; plan to grow Poland output over next two quarters.
Consolidated glass-lined production in India moved entirely to Gujarat facility from Hyderabad to improve cost absorption; Hyderabad facility on hold, not divested.
Rationalized UK manufacturing footprint; focusing on shifting manufacturing from high-cost Western countries to lower-cost locations like Poland, India, Brazil, China.
Consolidated order backlog ₹1,636 crores, down 3% YoY
Consolidated FY25 order intake ₹3,102 crores, up 3% YoY
Consolidated Q4 FY25 order intake ₹660 crores
Standalone order backlog ₹549 crores, up 20% YoY
Leven UK site closure to complete by Q2 FY26
FY25 order intake was INR 3102 crores, up 3% YoY; backlog on April 1, 2025 stands at INR 1636 crores
FY25 consolidated EBITDA margin was 11.9%; Q4 FY25 margin was 11.5% with 4% YoY growth
India business Q4 FY25 EBITDA margin was 17.4%; expects 15-16% margin achievable for FY26
UK Leven facility closure on track for Q2 FY26; all closure costs taken in FY25; Hyderabad facility shut down in Q3 FY25
Poland low-cost manufacturing site established; JV with 51% stake; expects 30% cost benefit vs Western Europe; revenue to triple in first year
India Gujarat factory starting third shift due to volume growth; Hyderabad production moved to Gujarat; Vatva heavy engineering facility has capacity for next 2 years
Expects better financial performance in FY26 vs FY25; India margins 15-16% achievable; international margins to improve with utilization recovery; no formal guidance given due to uncertainty
Post-acquisition mixing business expected to reach USD 60 million (~INR 513 cr) revenue and USD 8 million (~INR 68 cr) EBITDA
Consolidated EBITDA up 14% YoY; India EBITDA up 45% YoY; consolidated EBITDA margin 12.7%, standalone 15.7%
Order intake INR 1,004 crore, up 14% YoY and 52% QoQ; backlog INR 1,906 crore, up 7% YoY and 17% QoQ
India growth capex INR 7-10 crore for non-glass lined capacity (mixing, filtration, drying); maintenance capex ~2% of group revenue; heavy engineering capacity sufficient for 1.5 years
India glass lined ~80% utilisation, non-glass lined ~90%, heavy engineering ~80%; International 50-70% (lower in China); Poland JV expanding footprint with building permits for 3rd and 4th buildings

Standalone EBITDA margin 15-16% sustainable with upside from better absorption; expect India growth this year; international outlook cautious but pipeline growing; mixing targeting double-digit growth ex-China
Q2 FY26 order intake INR 878 cr; consolidated order backlog INR 2,146 cr including SEMCO
Target 15-20% improvement in India order backlog at start of next financial year
Aspire for double-digit growth in India; international growth may be slightly lower
Long-term leverage target below 1.0x
Q2 FY26 EBITDA INR 122 cr, margin 13.5%, up 20% QoQ and 27% YoY
No immediate capacity expansion planned for glass-lined India; can add furnaces quickly if needed
Poland JV investment INR 25 cr; SEMCO acquisition INR 162 cr (USD 18.5m) funded partly by EUR 10m debt
Karamsad glass-lined facility running three shifts, 5-6 month backlog, near full utilisation
Consolidated order intake for Q3 FY26 was ₹961 crore
Q3 order intake INR 961 crore, up 9% QoQ and 20% YoY; nine-month order intake up 16% YoY
Order backlog at INR 2,205 crore, highest ever, up 27% YoY
Expect Q4 to be strong in India for revenue, shipment and order intake; 30% higher backlog entering next financial year
Hyderabad facility land sale proceeds INR 55 crore expected this month
Heavy engineering capacity sufficient for INR 600-700 crore revenue; expansion possible to INR 1,000 crore within current site
Order intake ₹3,714 Cr, up 20% YoY
Backlog ₹2,194 Cr, up 34% YoY
Consolidated free cash flow generation ₹367 Cr (FY25 ₹318 Cr)
Management targets 15% consolidated EBITDA margin in medium term, currently at 11.5%
Order intake up 20% YoY to INR 3,714 crores; opening backlog up 34%
Full-year EBITDA margin improved 1 percentage point; Q4 margin dip attributed to product mix and cost increases
Poland facility at full capacity; need to build two more sheds soon
Poland facility commissioned as low-cost manufacturing hub for Europe
German restructuring to deliver INR 45 crores annual cost savings; exceptional items INR 65 crores this year (severance + India labor code)
Three-year strategic plan approved by Board; will articulate vision to capital markets in next few quarters (target Aug-Sep)
Vatva heavy engineering facility can reach INR 700-800 crores revenue with small investment; beyond that needs new facility
International EBITDA INR 264 crores; with INR 45 crores restructuring savings, like-for-like ~INR 309-310 crores
Repayment of approx. EUR 7 million of debt by end of Q2 FY27, funded through internal accruals
Revision of dividend payout frequency from semi-annual to annual, no change in Dividend Distribution Policy
Group-wide refinancing to restructure and reduce debt levels within next 12-18 months
Debt reduction already started and debt repayment of approx. EUR 7Mn planned for Q2FY27
Reviewing and simplifying legal entity structure within next 18-24 months for efficient tax structure
Plan to unwind intercompany loans between subsidiaries in different currency within next 12-18 months
Record order backlog of INR 2,289 crores, up 20% YoY and 4% QoQ, with Q1 order intake of INR 1,007 crores
Majority of Q1 order intake executable within 10-12 months, providing strong FY27 revenue visibility
Investing in global engineering centers (GEC) in India and Poland; consolidating non-critical activities to lower-cost geographies
HET expanding into nuclear, power, fertilizer, defence; Middle East oil & gas reordering; CRT service franchise growing
Consolidated order intake Q2 FY27 ₹1,198 Cr, up 19% QoQ and 36% YoY
FY27 revenue growth expected to be double-digit; reported EBITDA margin 10%-11% including loss-making entities; adjusted EBITDA margin 14%-15% for core business (80% of business)
claims.value: 10%-11% reported EBITDA margin; 14%-15% adjusted EBITDA margin

claims.statement: Record quarterly order inflow of INR 1,200 crores in Q2 FY27; India order intake INR 483 crores, highest ever and more than double sequentially; all four divisions contributed
Consolidated order backlog at record high of INR 2,446 crores, up 14% year-on-year, providing visibility for H2 FY27

Q2 FY27 reported EBITDA INR 110 crores (10.3% margin); excluding loss-making entities EBITDA would be INR 139 crores (15.9% margin); H1 reported EBITDA INR 204 crores (10.2% margin); adjusted H1 EBITDA INR 247 crores (15.2% margin)
Gross margins reduced due to loss-making European entities; expect improvement in H2 FY27 as pricing improves and operating leverage kicks in; confident of returning to past gross margin levels
Poland facility expansion underway; expected to come online by end of FY27 or start of FY28; new US facility opened for Edlon business to cater to semiconductor demand

Indian factory full; Heavy Engineering booked out till Q2 FY28; glass-lined business in India recovered well; Poland expansion to add capacity; Europe rationalizing footprint with UK closed and Germany workforce reduced
